posts.author: Dutchelm05
posts.content_md:
Yes Bob, I know that hologram well, it is not my favorite among all your great ones. Your wizard hologram is up there as my all time favorites.

I bought one of the gun holograms for about $100, and did get one set of the 25 DCGs as well ($150), The small 2.5x2x5 are pretty cool. The subjects they choose are quite funny, just grab anything that is small and shoot it. But they are great to look at. The small size is actually refreshing.

I don't think this subjected excited a lot of people, perhaps it has all been said.

But between these and the Larry Lieberman holo's that were just up it seems like they did not go for as much as I would have thought.

Oh well, glad I don't have to make a living at it 

Oh Bob if your still out there, any luck on finding that DCG SPIE paper?
